description: Systems lack adequate measures to ensure ongoing confidentiality of personal data. Confidentiality ensures that data is accessible only to authorized individuals, systems, and processes.
applicability: Applicable to all systems processing personal data. Includes access controls, authentication mechanisms, network segmentation, data classification, and employee training on confidentiality obligations.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through security audits, access control reviews, and code analysis. Look for missing authentication, weak authorization checks, overly permissive access rights, lack of role-based access control (RBAC), exposed APIs without authentication, and shared credentials. Review logging of data access events.

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Security of Processing
